svg.text: STAGE 431 · TOPIC 71 · P855 / P856 · SVG 75 🎉 · 865 GUARDS 🎉
Enterprise SIP RFC 7866 / RFC 6341 (SIPREC) Metadata XXE, Stream Binding & Fail-Closed Guard
企业 SIPREC (RFC 7866/6341) 双录元数据防 XXE、a=label 声道 [1,4] 轨双射锁与 SRS 断流 [500,3000]ms 故障安全熔断门禁（🎉 第 75 张 SVG 与 865 护栏双里程碑）
1. SIPREC Metadata XML XXE & a=label Stream Gate (P855)
• 痛点：application/rs-metadata+xml 注入 <!ENTITY> 触发 SRS 内网 SSRF 与任意文件读取
• 串轨风险：<stream><label> 与 SDP a=label 失配导致客户/AI 声道颠倒或跨通话串音
❌ Attack: <!DOCTYPE rs [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://169.254.169.254">]> | 12 streams
✅ P855 Gate: 0 DOCTYPE/ENTITY (SIP 400) + Bijective a=label + Streams in [1, 4]
Action: reject_siprec_xxe_or_unbound_label_with_400_and_clamp_streams
确定性收敛指标（P855）：
✔ clampedXxeOrUnboundStreamMetadataPayloads = 0（100% 阻断 XXE 与错绑声道标签）
✔ clampedRecordedMediaStreamsPerSession ∈ [1, 4]（主叫上行 / AI 下行 / 耳语 / 同屏）
2. SRS Media-Fork Watchdog & Fail-Closed Quarantine (P856)
• 痛点：SRS 录音服断流时默认 Fail-Open 继续执行电汇/投保，触发 MiFID II / 银保监重罚
• 恢复与熔断：[500, 3000]ms 看门狗触发 3s 环形缓冲切备；若全断则立即冻结写操作工具
❌ Fail-Open Breach: SRS 503 / RTP stall -> AI still commits $50k wire transfer
✅ P856 Gate: [500, 3000]ms Watchdog + Standby SRS Replay + Fail-Closed Write Lock
Action: failover_srs_or_quarantine_regulated_write_tools_fail_closed
确定性收敛指标（P856）：
✔ clampedUnrecordedRegulatedTransactionCommits = 0（0 笔无双录裸奔交易提交）
✔ clampedSrsFailoverWatchdogTimeoutMs ∈ [500, 3000] ms（毫秒级环缓热切与写隔离）
